name: 34535-randomdecode-qwen3moe30b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1), host DRAM behind PCIe Gen5 x16.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1. ~57 GiB of weights, of which 30 GiB are held in host memory by declaration.
architecture: sparse mixture-of-experts decoder (Qwen3MoeForCausalLM, 48 layers), bf16 weights, ~57 GiB in 16 safetensors shards; the rest is on its own config.json.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=1 (pinned, not searched), warmup 20%, bounded at 30 requests with an 1800 s safety cap -- 24 counted requests.
workload: synthetic_text, single turn, fixed by construction at exactly 100 prompt tokens and 100 output tokens per request (min=max on both), no prefix buckets and no length distribution; `request_format: plain`, a raw completion string with no chat template.
purpose: A single-user text completion service on a 30-billion-parameter sparse expert model, handling 100-token prompts and replies on one GPU.
launch:
model: Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B

tensor-parallel-size: 1

# Part of the declared deployment, not a knob: these weight bytes live in host DRAM and are read
# over the host link during the forward pass. Fixed.
cpu-offload-gb: 30

dtype: bfloat16

max-num-seqs: 2

max-model-len: 4096

gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90

enforce-eager: false
